description: This file contains build definitions, functions, device configurations, and instructions for building firmware images for various hardware platforms, specifically focusing on imx CPU targets within the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: Build/boot-overlay
methods.description: Creates a bootable overlay directory with kernel image, device tree blobs, boot scripts, and UBIFS image, then packages it into a tarball.

methods.name: Build/bootfs.tar.gz
methods.description: Prepares a boot filesystem tarball by extracting and recompressing kernel and other boot files.

methods.name: Build/recovery-scr
methods.description: Generates a recovery bootscript image for the device.

methods.name: Build/apalis-emmc
methods.description: Prepares an emmc image by calling multiple image preparation steps.

methods.name: Build/ventana-img
methods.description: Builds a customized image for Ventana devices, including kernel, device tree blobs, bootscript, and packaging.
